user.title: Yunmi Kettle (Mi Smart Kettle Pro)
user.description: Connects over Bluetooth (incl. ESPHome proxy). Get the MAC and token with the Xiaomi cloud token extractor.

data_description.token: The 24-character BLE beaconkey; a 32-character MiIO token will not work.
data_description.name: The device name shown in Home Assistant.
data_description.poll_interval: Fallback full snapshot interval. Push notifications remain immediate.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the kettle BLE key
reauth_confirm.description: The kettle rejected its saved BLE beaconkey. Enter the current 24-character beaconkey while the kettle is powered on.

data_description.token: The replacement 24-character BLE beaconkey is hidden while typing.

error.miot_token_not_supported: This looks like a 32-character MiIO token. This kettle needs its 24-character BLE beaconkey instead.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the kettle. Check it's powered, in range of a Bluetooth adapter/proxy, and that its Bluetooth isn't held by the phone.
error.invalid_auth: Login failed — the token is wrong for this kettle.

abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a Mi Smart Kettle Pro (yunmi.kettle.v14).

authentication_failed.message: The kettle rejected its BLE beaconkey. Reauthentication has been started.
